category_key.label: Works
category_key.definition: Current scoped evidence proves protocol, tools, backend operation, Wright gateway execution, outcome, and cleanup.
category_key.action: Keep the scoped qualification current and disclose its limits.

category_key.label: Preview
category_key.definition: Useful execution checks passed, but complete scoped Wright qualification is unfinished.
category_key.action: Complete the named missing backend, gateway, or outcome checks.

category_key.label: Requires login
category_key.definition: Unauthenticated testing reached an observed account, key, or OAuth boundary; post-login scope remains unverified.
category_key.action: Use a test account to verify tools, one safe operation, and Wright gateway execution.

category_key.label: In progress
category_key.definition: Testing, repair, evidence review, renewal, host software, license, hardware, or a lab environment remains.
category_key.action: Complete the recorded next action and review the result.

category_key.label: Abandoned
category_key.definition: A reviewed decision closed evaluation because the entry is retired, superseded, duplicate, unavailable, unsuitable, or no longer worth pursuing.
category_key.action: Retain the decision record; restore only after a reviewed material change.

category_key.label: Blocked by vendor
category_key.definition: An attributable vendor restriction explicitly asks that this integration or use not proceed.
category_key.action: Respect the restriction and review only when the vendor position changes.

green.meaning: Technically assessed under the recorded policy; this is not customer adoption.

limitations: This report evaluates recorded evidence; it does not run live qualification.
Candidate stage assignments describe intended coverage, not proven end-to-end handoffs.
MHS is a research preview; Wright has not qualified physical device operation.
Passing means the recorded scoped qualification remains current; it does not extend to untested tools, platforms, or host modes.
The three chains are deterministic Tier 1 integration scenarios, not physical product validation or production process proof.
